Four apps, one place

The Nextcloud apps you use, made for your phone

Each module works on its own, so you only need the server apps you use.

Deck

A kanban board in your pocket

  • Boards with lists and cards you can drag and reorder
  • Labels, due dates, assignees, checklists, attachments and comments
  • Upcoming: everything that's due, grouped into overdue, today and the next few days
  • Card cover photos

Notes

Markdown notes, found fast

  • Markdown notes with categories and favourites
  • Fast search across all your notes
  • Several list styles to browse the way you like

News

An RSS reader with no algorithm

  • Your feeds and folders from Nextcloud News
  • Unread and starred articles, marked as read as you scroll
  • Rename, move or unsubscribe from feeds without leaving the app

Bookmarks

A bookmark manager that syncs

  • Folders, tags and search, with the site icons your server stores
  • Find duplicates and broken links
  • Share bookmarks and folders
Built for self-hosted servers

Your server, your network, your rules

Made for the Nextcloud you run yourself, at home or anywhere else.

Works offline

Create and edit cards, notes and bookmarks without a signal. Your changes upload when the network comes back.

Sign in your way

Straight to your server through the browser with Nextcloud's Login Flow, with your username and password, or by scanning a QR code.

Self-signed certificates

Install your own CA on the phone and the app trusts your server. Plain HTTP works on your local network. How to install a certificate

Your data stays yours

Your cards, notes, bookmarks and feeds go between your phone and your Nextcloud, nowhere else. No account with us, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Privacy policy

Made for Android

  • Share from any app into a card, a note or a bookmark
  • Two panes on tablets and foldables
  • Material You colours
